Hurdles

  1. Three races over six hurdles; your fastest time counts.
  2. Tap the screen, or press space, to start. The runner speeds up by itself.
  3. Tap again to jump. A marker hangs over the next hurdle: tap when it turns green and TAP flashes.
  4. A jump timed so you are at the top of it over the hurdle gives a burst of speed. Knock a hurdle and you slow right down.
  5. The clock stops at the finish line.
